slices.title: Import a skill from a file
slices.summary: Adds POST /api/v1/skills/import in capability-core (multipart single SKILL.md or zip within 256 files / 8 MiB / 1 MiB per file), parsed with the existing skillbundle validator, creating a scope=user row (org scope admin-only) whose body goes into the S5 draft and whose bundle is state 'draft', then linted by S4. Nothing is live until publish. Adds an Import button and skills.import action; refuses ZDR principals. Requires SKILL_BUNDLES_ENABLED and SKILL_DRAFT_PUBLISH. No proto or migration.
slices.remaining: Waits on D4 (member authoring) and D9 (ZDR posture of bundle upload/import: recommendation allow, same ruling as EP-5 OD-4, register D2-384). Flag stays off until D2-379/D2-383 (bundle read authz) are fixed. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]

slices.title: App-initiated tools/call: viewer-bound, same server, read class only, through ExecuteStep
slices.summary: New MG mcp_app_calls.rs: switch MCP_APP_TOOL_CALLS (literal true, default off), refuses ZDR (mcp_execution), viewer must own the run that drew the app, tool on the app's own server and allowlisted, registry class none/read only (else app_call_requires_chat), 10 calls per frame per minute keyed by a SPA frame nonce, calls execution-core ExecuteStep{tool mcp__..., permission_mode ask, run_id, user_id} with the viewer's delegated bearer as tools.rs does for code_interpreter, output scrubbed and capped 64 KiB, audit line without arguments. http_routes.rs POST /v1/mcp-apps/tool-call additive block, typed envelope errors. BFF pass-through. FE bridge forwards tools/call via chat-client callMcpAppTool when VITE_MCP_APP_TOOL_CALLS === 'true'; action contract chat.mcp_app_tool_call (risk medium). Execution-core arm added only if ExecuteStep lacks mcp__ dispatch through the signed gate.

slices.title: Agent API read and control routes in model-gateway
slices.summary: New agent_api_routes.rs: GET /v1/agent/runs/:run_id, GET /v1/agent/runs/:run_id/events (delegates to the run events SSE), POST /v1/agent/runs/:run_id/cancel, GET /v1/agent/threads/:thread_id/runs and /messages, all typed envelopes with the S3 codes. MG/auth.rs admits an api_key principal on these routes only while MODEL_GATEWAY_AGENT_API is on and only with scope agent:runs, and accepts exactly one x-session-authorization api_key bearer bound to the same key_id, org and zdr (new VerifiedApiKeySessionBearer). Off: the INNH-10 key-grant pair is the whole allow-list, responses byte-identical.
